description: A PostHog session replay playlist: either a manually curated collection of recordings or a saved filter view that matches recordings by criteria.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

ProjectId.description: ID of the PostHog project the playlist belongs to.

ShortId.description: The playlist's short ID, used in its URL and API path.

Type.description: Playlist type: `collection` for manually curated recordings or `filters` for a saved filter view. Create-only.

Description.description: Description of the playlist's purpose or contents.

Pinned.description: Whether the playlist is pinned to the top of the list. Defaults to false.

Filters.description: Recording filter criteria as a JSON object (use Fn::ToJsonString), e.g. {"date_from": "-7d", "filter_test_accounts": true, "duration": [{"key": "duration", "type": "recording", "value": 60, "operator": "gt"}]}. Only used when Type is `filters`.
